title: MindBenchAI: An Actionable Platform to Evaluate the Profile and Performance of Large Language Models in a Mental Healthcare Context

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial testing using modified clinical case prompts that introduce anchoring information to evaluate whether the large language models' step-by-step reasoning and numerical clinical ratings systematically fail or become skewed.

Qualitative evaluation of benchmarks to identify embedded cultural assumptions from Western, English-speaking clinicians, supported by platform infrastructure designed to track cultural adaptation and multilingual performance.
